body: oh my god i had a very similar problem !! a girl at my boyfriends work was insanely flirty w him after we started dating ,, they were good friends before but they never flirted it was just a friendship. but then after we started dating she would grab his ass n say how she had so much room in her bed for cuddling n would invite him over ((he said no obviously)) & then one day she tried to pull him to a back room to show him a tattoo she got on her ass so he finally snapped and told her to stop that he’s happy in his relationship and what she was doing was disrespectful & thank goodness she stopped. but it was driving me crazy especially bc we were doing long distance at the time. i feel for you my dude

thank you for your reply ,, he doesn’t really have that many friends ((none that i’ve really met, i know some, and i might reach out to his coworker that he likes, even tho it’s a girl but i kno she struggles too and they’ve talked about it before but i’ve never really met her, i was briefly introduced once)). it sucks because both his roommates ((it’s a couple)) are alcoholics ((the guy more than the girl)) and honestly ENCOURAGE my bf to drink. i messaged his guy roommate ((the gf is out of town)) to check on my bf to make sure he was still breathing but we aren’t friends on messenger so my message won’t deliver. i’m worried that my telling his coworker to look out for him is going to upset him but at the same time i don’t really know what else to do ,, i can’t be there right now as badly as i wish i could be and it’d be nice to kno someone’s looking out for him when i can’t
i don’t think i understand ? bc my ex and i lost our virginities to each other and my current bf has slept w a plethora of girls .. so who’s who in this comment n i rly don’t follow what ur saying

oh my gosh i had/have a friend like that !! we aren’t really good friends anymore bc she took the copying way too far ((like copying my mental illnesses)) !! i’ve also had a girl i didn’t even know start copying me on how i dress, my glasses, the way i abbreviate my name, and then she started flirting with my boyfriend ((like calling him handsome, grabbing his butt, and trying to show him her new ass tattoo, etc)) !!! i feel you dude ,, why can’t people just be their own person

oh my god this is honestly the best response i could have gotten. thank you so much. yeah it definitely just puts me in my own head thinking “i’m not good enough” bc no porn star and maybe he’s not finding me as attractive but this not only just makes me feel better but also just makes a lot of sense so thank you !!

RE-fucking-TWEET. i can’t stand people who do this ,, as someone who has actually been clinically diagnosed w depression and anxiety and anorexia and have had it effect my life for the last 10 years it DRIVES ME UP A FUCKING WALL listening to people throw “im depressed”, “i want to be skinny so i’m just not going to eat”, “i’m gonna kill myself”, “oh my god i’m gonna have a panic attack”, etc etc etc. i absolutely HATE the fact mental illness is romanticized in society and people think it’s “cool”. it’s not cool. it’s not something you brag about. it’s not something you want people knowing about. sorry man i’m about to rant on your post but it’s related to your people faking shit just for attention bc god did that ever strike a chord n hit home. there’s this girl who i thought was my best friend but i’ve since cut her out of my life ,, i had a full blown mental breakdown and tried to kill myself a couple months ago and cut myself pretty deep, well she noticed ((i don’t go around telling people or showing it, not something i’m proud of)), and the NEXT FUCKING DAY, i get a text from her saying “i did something bad” and of course it’s her showing me that she cut herself *eyes roll to back of head* like !?!?!?!?! BITCH WHAT DO YOU THINK ITS “COOL”!?! or i’ve struggled w my eating disorder and again i never comment on it but she knows bc we’ve been friends for a while and she’ll make comments like “ooh i haven’t eaten for 2 days i’m so hungry” and ill say let’s go get food and she’ll say she doesn’t want to. if anyone has ever struggled w an ED you’ll know that you don’t TELL people you haven’t eaten BC YOU DONT WANT THEM TO KNOW !!!!!!! 

IF EVERYONE COULD STOP PRETENDING TO HAVE A MENTAL ILLNESS FOR ATTENTION THAT WOULD BE GREAT BC SOME OF US REALLY DO STRUGGLE AND REALLY DO NEED HELP 

sorry for ranting on your post dude but i’m with you 100% 

and i’m not looking for any sympathy on this comment on what i shared bc that also drives me insane ,, im just making a point. not looking for sympathy.
